_comment: Issue #97 step 1b: single corner TYP 27 C 3.63 V, 200 ns transient, timeout_s 1800. Effective clock period at the divider (ck = cml2cmos output, ckl = buffered divider clock) over 100 cycles from td=100n, and tc/fb levels in 100-200 ns, to see whether the counter is miscounting or is missing clock pulses.

measurements.name: ipavg
measurements.spice: .meas tran ipavg avg i(vddp) from=40n to=200n

measurements.name: idavg
measurements.spice: .meas tran idavg avg i(vddd) from=40n to=200n

measurements.name: fbmax
measurements.spice: .meas tran fbmax max v(fb) from=40n to=200n

measurements.name: fbmin
measurements.spice: .meas tran fbmin min v(fb) from=40n to=200n

measurements.name: tck100
measurements.spice: .meas tran tck100 trig v(xdiv.ck) val=1.65 td=100n rise=1 targ v(xdiv.ck) val=1.65 td=100n rise=101

measurements.name: tck10
measurements.spice: .meas tran tck10 trig v(xdiv.ck) val=1.65 td=100n rise=1 targ v(xdiv.ck) val=1.65 td=100n rise=11

measurements.name: ckmax
measurements.spice: .meas tran ckmax max v(xdiv.ck) from=100n to=200n

measurements.name: ckmin
measurements.spice: .meas tran ckmin min v(xdiv.ck) from=100n to=200n

measurements.name: tckl100
measurements.spice: .meas tran tckl100 trig v(xdiv.ckl) val=1.65 td=100n rise=1 targ v(xdiv.ckl) val=1.65 td=100n rise=101

measurements.name: tckl10
measurements.spice: .meas tran tckl10 trig v(xdiv.ckl) val=1.65 td=100n rise=1 targ v(xdiv.ckl) val=1.65 td=100n rise=11

measurements.name: cklmax
measurements.spice: .meas tran cklmax max v(xdiv.ckl) from=100n to=200n

measurements.name: cklmin
measurements.spice: .meas tran cklmin min v(xdiv.ckl) from=100n to=200n

measurements.name: tcmax2
measurements.spice: .meas tran tcmax2 max v(xdiv.tc) from=100n to=200n

measurements.name: tcmin2
measurements.spice: .meas tran tcmin2 min v(xdiv.tc) from=100n to=200n

measurements.name: fblmax2
measurements.spice: .meas tran fblmax2 max v(fb) from=100n to=200n

measurements.name: fblmin2
measurements.spice: .meas tran fblmin2 min v(fb) from=100n to=200n

measurements.name: tcr1
measurements.spice: .meas tran tcr1 when v(xdiv.tc)=1.65 td=40n rise=1

measurements.name: tcf1
measurements.spice: .meas tran tcf1 when v(xdiv.tc)=1.65 td=40n fall=1

measurements.name: tcr2

measurements.name: tcf2
measurements.spice: .meas tran tcf2 when v(xdiv.tc)=1.65 td=40n fall=2
